reading.title: Extended Family: Personal Message
reading.text: Omar tells Nora, “My great-aunt is my grandfather’s sister, and my great-uncle is my grandmother’s brother. My sister’s daughter is my niece; my brother’s son is my nephew. I informally call my cousin’s husband a cousin-in-law. My wife’s parents are my mother-in-law and father-in-law; her siblings are my sister-in-law and brother-in-law.” Nora replies, “My daughter’s husband is my son-in-law; my son’s wife is my daughter-in-law. In-laws are family connections through marriage. Spouse’s family is clear wording; extended in-laws and family-in-law are informal descriptions.”
